title: Chapter 1519 - 625: Female Mechanism Expert Beats Up Male Gold Fighter
content:
Chapter 1519: Chapter 625: Female Mechanism Expert Beats Up Male Gold Fighter

Listening to the taunting of the Flowing Gold Guest, Ning Zhuo’s eyes flickered slightly, his expression calm as he directed most of his Divine Sense to manage the Defensive Wheel Slash Formation.

The swords, blades, axes, and hooks no longer aimed to slash vital points, but to suppress and entangle instead. The Sword Armor pressured the shoulder of the Flowing Gold Guest, the Sword Armor forced him to turn, the Axe Armor intercepted his charge, and the Hook Armor restricted his steps.

The Humbleheart Broken-Blade Guard on the other side was fully entangled with the Blood Talisman Clone of the Flowing Gold Guest, unable to offer support.

Chun Yangzi frowned slightly, the scripture on his Red Gold Robe seemed to dim a bit.

The Red Robe Guest tapped the armrest, unable to suppress a grin, "Why is this kid dragging on so hard? Why hasn’t he revealed more of his hand?"

Ning Zhuo, who was previously manipulating the Defensive Wheel Slash Formation to deal damage, had now changed his tactical target to entanglement, immediately slowing down the Flowing Gold Guest’s offensive momentum.

The Flowing Gold Guest suddenly found his aggressive assault feeling like it was mired in a swamp, with many hits falling short, causing frustration to simmer in his heart.

Jin Mantang’s smile was full of disdainful anger, he realized, "This Ning Zhuo, at this moment, is still honing his Mystic Armor’s battle formation tactics? He’s just a mere Foundation Establishment Mid-Stage, yet he doesn’t take the likes of the Flowing Gold Guest with Golden Core Peak Battle Power seriously!"

At this moment, in terms of battle power, the Flowing Gold Guest was indeed at the Golden Core Level Peak.

Tan Zhu’s eyes were deep, "Even until now, Ning Zhuo hasn’t revealed his hand. The Flowing Gold Guest’s battle power has indeed been greatly amplified, but his mindset is not calm enough, overly focused on defeating Ning Zhuo, immersed in a huge desire for victory, without seeing the true state of the battle."

Many astute cultivators abandoned the apparent "huge advantage" of the Flowing Gold Guest and saw the composure beneath the surface of Ning Zhuo.

Crack, crack...

After a prolonged battle, the Mysterious Armor·Old Cold Leg was the first to become unbearable, as many cracks suddenly appeared on its surface. The fine, brittle sound of cracking was directly drowned out by the roaring of the battlefield, the roars and laughs of the Flowing Gold Guest.

Next, the Mysterious Armors below the Golden Core Level successively showed signs of strain.

Although the focus was on entanglement, ultimately, under the wild attacks of the Flowing Gold Guest, many Mysterious Armors showed signs of fatigue.

Cao Gui moved his lips but didn’t speak.

Huoniao’er instinctively clenched his jaw, worried for Ning Zhuo.

Ning Zhuo opened his third Magic Pool!

The Soul Absorption Box also began to operate at this moment.

The wooden box was strapped to his back, its lid opening and closing, and the Five Elements Spirit Talismans lit up one by one. The surrounding spiritual energy was absorbed into the box, then converted into usable mana, channeled along the mechanism into Ning Zhuo’s body.

Compared to the Mysterious Armor, Ning Zhuo’s mana reserves were in an even worse situation.

The Swallowing Gold Divine Domain did not spare the Soul Absorption Box either.

Inside the Soul Absorption Box, several metal clips, pivots, and mana-conducting metal sheets were rapidly extracting Gold Qi under the influence of the Black Gold Divine Light while operating.

The flow of the talisman array inside the box, which was initially smooth, soon began to show slight stutters.

Ning Zhuo quickly noticed this, his expression unchanged, and had to allocate additional Divine Sense and mana to maintain the stability of the Soul Absorption Box.

The Cloud Tide Replenishing Talisman ignited right after!

Inside his lapel, the talisman transformed into a wave-like spiritual energy, surging into his body.

The Five Qi Returning Essence Pill was also placed in Ning Zhuo’s mouth, the elixir power transforming into five strands of clear energy of Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth, channeling into the mana cycle of the Five Elements Qi Regulation Art.

Any one of these means would be enough to make ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivators enviously hot-eyed.

But compared to the Flowing Gold Guest, even when combined, they were outshone!

A Golden Blood Pill Pearl inside the Flowing Gold Guest dispersed, with golden mist gushing from deep within his flesh.

The next moment, all his injuries converged, his aura rose, mana replenished, and his essence blood revived.

He didn’t need to use a Magic Pool, nor talismans for conversion, nor even elixir pills for replenishment.

This power was his innate skill, grown directly from himself, straightforward and domineering, like an underground spring bursting forth, flooding all the gaps within his body.

This is the Quasi-Divine Power Level Golden Liquid Returning Pill Body!

From the start of the battle, it had been fully supporting him, forming an overwhelming advantage!

In the Martial Arts Arena, Ning Zhuo continuously retreated.

The Green Forest Python Chariot’s speed was much reduced due to its metal wheel axis being affected by the Swallowing Gold Divine Domain.

The movements of the Humbleheart Broken-Blade Guard were noticeably slower by a fraction, greatly increasing the difficulty for Ning Zhuo to maneuver.

The Mechanical Bird Group continued to incur losses under the Chaotic String Split Sound Fork.

The Defensive Wheel Slash Formation formed by the Mysterious Armor made little progress.

And although Ning Zhuo’s Fire-attribute Spell was domineering, reaching Golden Core Level, and still able to scorch the Flowing Gold Guest, it was ultimately neutralized by the Fire Extinguishing Pill, Flame Avoidance Blood Protection Pill, and Quasi-Divine Powers combined.

"Ning Zhuo is about to fall," Zhao Ni said in a low voice, joy evident on his face.

Ye Qingming quietly watched the battle, carefully observing Ning Zhuo’s expression. The young man’s face appeared pale due to the severe consumption of mana and Divine Sense, but his gaze was still like a light in a deep well, unextinguished despite the tumultuous water.

The Flowing Gold Guest grew more and more excited with each fight, the golden light in his eyes so intense that others couldn’t look directly at him.

"Ning Zhuo!" He shattered the Sword Armor with a fork, his Golden Blood exploding, closing in within ten feet.

"Kneel and beg for mercy, and I may spare your life!"

He had never considered taking Ning Zhuo’s life. Too many people thought highly of Ning Zhuo, and if he were to truly kill him, the many experts of Nanming Village would never let the Flowing Gold Guest off.

The Flowing Gold Guest knew very well, his support from the numerous factions of Flowing Cloud Peak was only because he was framed by Ning Zhuo, becoming the most convenient tool for the various factions of Flowing Cloud Peak.

But he was just a tool, not a death soldier.

He bore no loyalty to the various factions of Flowing Cloud Peak. He also knew clearly in his heart: to some extent, he should even thank Ning Zhuo. Without Ning Zhuo "elevating" him, how could he have received such high-level support?
